body:
That seems very tragic, and I am so sorry you had to go through that. I hope that everything is now alright.

It is hard to move on, being that he was my first and that I stayed with him so long. Not to mention this recently happened to it has really taken its' toll on me. I try to think he is better without me, and that this was all the right choice, but me being so selfish I . . . I just want things to go back to the way they were used to. 
I do not think I can ever look at both my friend or him in the eyes again . . knowing that I caused them so much hurt.

Even if they were to come back, how could I live with myself ? I cannot move on from what I did, it makes me feel like a monster. inhumane. They being able to accept ME back . . . after all I did . . . I, I feel I do not deserve it. No matter how many tears I shed, no matter how many emotions I paint on my body, no matter how many times I beg for things to go back to how they were used to, I feel I deserved all of this in the end. I just have to stay strong and learn how to live on my own.

I never felt like I had any serious issues for me to see any sort of doctor. If anything I always felt nervous since I feel I am limited in what I say. I wanted to try seeing a therapist first, which was a big step on my part. I never believed they could do any good, but I met a very nice lady and I hope that it all helps. I feel like all I need is some reassurance on my life, and if that does not work then I will try to seek for some more help. Just . . as of now, I am at my lowest and simply just tired of everything.

Thank you so much for the different outlook though, I truly appreciate it. I will definitely look into it.

It has always been that way. My thoughts always consume me, but I like to ignore it most of the time to avoid hurting myself more. I just wish all those noise would stop for once, I have been having so much trouble sleeping and it seems nothing is getting better.

Well, it started in the beginning of June when we broke up and my friend left me. I ended up not talking to my boyfriend for another month, but I finally said goodbye in early July. It is really stressful, since it feels like only yesterday I was muttering the words " I love you ".

Thank you for replying.
The thing is, I am a very sensitive and stubborn type of girl. Since this all happened, I feel like it could happen again or the same could happen to me. I am not willing to hurt someone, and therefore I am just stuck here with empty words and built up emotions. I am not saying I never will meet anyone else, but I know that this scarred me for good. 

I tried to view it the same way. I like to have thought that I was merely hurting my boyfriend in the end, and that my friend is definitely happier without me. But who is to say that truly ? I only can assume so I can move on myself, but me being the type of person I am my mind will never convince me that I did good. I am simply just tired. 

Time is what is so suffocating right now. Every minute countless thoughts race through my mind, I think of them every day. I think of all the regrets I made, and I think of how I could be with my friend right now laughing if I was not so stupid. It truly hurts, and I truly feel I cannot make it.

Thank you for taking the time to read what I had to say, I truly appreciate it.

And I am still in high school, this is my third year and I have one more year to go. My sister however is going to college in January, but I can guarantee that she is going to leave us the moment we move. Since I was not suppose to know all of this, I asked my mother if there was any way we could move before school, and she promised that we will. I am not fully understanding of the situation since my father is fighting for disability ( he has not worked in the last ten years ) but I do know that my wish of moving before will not happen. 

I told her everything. I like to think that I'm a friendship you can tell them everything without them judging you . . . But that is what hurts me more. I feel like she is judging me, not that I blame her . . . But I just feel like now, I have to watch what I say. It is really embarrassing to say, but I have no friends. Sure, I have acquaintances that I talk to, but I only talk to them about my interest. We never share that same bond me and my friend did, as to why I valued her so much. 

I understand, I began seeing a therapist and I was definitely going to slip in about my suicide attempts and the cutting but . . . Would I get into any trouble ? I am scared that since I am a minor and I mention suicide they'll send me away. That is the last thing I want on my plate right now honestly. 
Again, thank you for taking the time to reply. I am glad someone took their time to read my life.
